issues.reason: 'Was expected to strengthen' is the Impersonal reported attitude shape — an agentless passive attitude matrix over a non-finite complement, with 'expect' itself listed among the non-factive attitude verbs — so it must reify the attitude with no Experiencer and seal the complement; the epistemic (Probably e) route is reserved for seem / appear, which have no holder at all, and substituting it deletes the reported expectation and states the strengthening as probable in its own right.

The intransitive-subject test puts a non-volitional natural force that undergoes rather than initiates its motion on Patient (as the parse itself does for sk_move_1), so (Agent sk_makelandfall_1 hurricane_claudette) attributes volition to the same hurricane in the same motion and contradicts the parse's own role assignment.

gaps_confirmed: a proper-noun modifier on a common-noun head ('the Texas coast') — the naming rules cover a lowercase adjective before a name and a kind word inside or beside it, not a name modifying a following head noun
directional 'toward' (motion in a direction without reaching it) — Goal is defined for 'to'/'into'/'onto' and is described as recording the resulting location, which the sentence does not claim
new_gaps: 'expect' is not in the Impersonal reported attitudes verb list ('considered / regarded / thought / said / believed / reported / rumored'), and the raised-subject passive 'X was expected to V' (as opposed to 'to be P') is not spelled out anywhere
